name: Murayama Noan
source:
The second waitress of Radish, Noan Murayama is roughly the same as Oruha, though she is more gentle and easygoing. Setsuna looks up to her as a role model.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_School_Days_characters]Wikipedia[/url]]
